title: KPI-gated circuit sentinel for geo/tier routing (region selection & variant fallback)
creator: Ava Chen
description:
Problem: During cross-region load spikes we have inconsistent behavior between regional tiering and variant fallbacks. Current reactive thresholds (static 429/timeouts) either flip too aggressively for transient spikes or wait too long and cause tail latency and customer errors. We need a sentinel that gates automatic region/tier circuit decisions against short-term KPIs (429 rate, p99 latency, timeout ratio) with hysteresis, probe-based verification, and a soft-open mode that gradually resumes traffic.

Goal: Implement a KPI-gated circuit sentinel that integrates with smart routing to: 1) trigger fast, low-risk fallbacks when sustained KPI degradation is detected, 2) avoid noisy flips during bursty traffic via smoothing/decay windows, 3) include an active probe step before re-opening a circuit, and 4) provide clear observability and audit events for operator and customer-facing debugging.

Scope: This ticket focuses on the decision service and sentinel orchestration for geo and tier routing. It will: update the threshold evaluation pipeline, add a probe action type, implement soft-open re-introduction logic, and emit structured telemetry events to the Console + Grafana dashboards. Changes to concrete serving kernels or model variants are out of scope and will be handled by downstream rollout tickets.

Non-goals: full multi-tenant per-API quotas, billing changes, or replacing existing circuit logic in dedicated control plane until we validate heuristics in staging.
acceptance_criteria: Sentinel evaluates KPI windows (1m, 5m, 15m) and produces a trip decision event when composite score exceeds configurable threshold
Trip events include reason vectors: 429_rate, p99_latency_ms, timeout_ratio, error_rate and are emitted to telemetry as structured logs (JSON) and to Grafana via metrics bridge
On trip, routing decisions mark region/tier as soft-failed and route <= 10% probe traffic to the region for verification
Soft-open re-introduction follows exponential backoff with success/failure counters; re-open requires two successful probe windows back-to-back
A test harness (integration tests) simulates bursts and validates no-flip behavior during <30s transient spikes and proper trip after sustained 5m degradation
Dashboard panel (grafana) created with trip timeline, composite score, and per-tenant impact; links added to Console route detail view
Documentation added to Confluence and Playbook: runbook + rollback steps
comments: 2026-02-25 - Ava Chen: Initial triage and problem writeup. Mapped to project regional-routing-sentinels. Suggested scoring heuristic: weighted sum(429_rate * 0.4, p99_latency_norm * 0.3, timeout_ratio * 0.2, error_rate * 0.1). Need infra to calculate p99_norm across heterogeneous model families.

2026-02-26 - Marcus Patel: Spike smoothing approach chosen: combination of EWMA (alpha=0.3) on 1m window and decaying trip score over 15m. Will prototype in decision-service branch. Assigned estimate 5.

2026-02-28 - PM Sofia Lopez: Reviewed trade-offs. Ask: add per-tenant probation window so a single noisy tenant doesn't force regional handoff. Action: add 'tenant-weighted' flag to composite calculation (default false).

2026-03-01 - Design (Ibrahim Torres): UX for Console: show 'soft-failed' badge and probe traffic ratio. Created mockups in Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abcdef/Geo-Sentinels-Mockups. Please review before PR.

2026-03-02 - Marcus Patel: Implemented signal aggregation and scoring prototype. PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/5042. Unit tests for scoring function added. Blocker: staged Grafana metrics bridge needs an endpoint for structured trip events (opened infra ticket).

2026-03-03 - Reliability (Leah Kim): Feedback: Probe traffic should be explicitly meterable and capped per-tenant. Also recommend a circuit 'shadow' mode to record decision outcomes without affecting routing for one release cycle. Adding as follow-up (sub-issue).

test_plan: Unit: scoring function edge cases and EWMA smoothing correctness
Integration: simulated clients generating bursty 429/timeouts to verify no-flip under transient load (<30s)
Chaos: induce region-wide timeouts in staging and validate probe re-introduction and soft-open behavior
Canary: shadow mode for 48h in production routes before enabling traffic shaping
